title: Christian religion alone free of falsehood; antiquity with humankind; preservation through persecutions
pass_a_gloss: The reason of the major is that besides the Christian religion there is no religion in the world which cannot be convicted of the false, the absurd, even of novelty; in the Christian alone nothing false can be demonstrated. The true religion has such antiquity that it has been as long as men have been (Gen. 1; Eusebius). It is certain the true religion will last unto the end of the world. Yet all Greek and Roman superstitions have perished; ours endures through Egyptian bondage, Babylonian captivity, Alexander, Antiochus Epiphanes, the Romans, the overthrow of the Jewish polity, emperors, Julian the Apostate. From all which we firmly conclude our religion rests on the providence of GOD and has been preserved from the founding of the world — which can be demonstrated of no other. Therefore the Christian alone is true, or none is true: which was to be demonstrated.
pass_b_english: The major rests on two foundations: what cannot be absent from the true religion belongs to no pagan religion; those marks belong to the Christian alone. False, absurd, and shameful things can be shown of Greek, Persian, and Roman superstitions, not of the Christian. The true religion has such antiquity that it has been as long as humans have ([[Genesis 1 >> Bible:Genesis 1]]; Eusebius), and pagan gods' very birthdays are known while the Hebrew-Christian religion began with humankind.

It is certain the true religion will last to the world's end. Yet pagan superstitions have perished. Ours endures through Egyptian bondage, Babylonian captivity, Alexander's wars, Antiochus Epiphanes (Josephus Ant. 12.7), Rome before Daniel's period ([[Daniel 9 >> Bible:Daniel 9]]), the polity's overthrow, emperors' fury, and Julian's temple grant (Ammianus 23.17). We conclude our religion rests on God's providence from the world's founding — which can be shown of no other. Therefore the Christian religion alone is true, or there is no true religion in the world — which was to be demonstrated.
source_text: Sola Christiana a falso/absurdo/novitate immunis; antiquitas cum hominibus (Gen. 1; Eusebius); duratio ad finem mundi per Aegyptum, Babylonem, Alexandrum, Antiochum, Romanos, eversionem politiae, imperatores, Julianum. Ergo sola Christiana vera, aut nulla vera — Q.E.D.
